### The `encodeBody` option

Workers adds an `encodeBody` option in `ResponseInit` that controls how the response body is compressed. Set this to `"manual"` when serving pre-compressed data to prevent automatic compression.

conclusion: Cloudflare explicitly documents unread origin response.body plus preserved Content-Encoding passed to new Response with automatic/default encodeBody. This differs from Node Fetch decoding; Node mocks only check preservation at the worker source boundary.
